title: BloodDrop_ Pack
description: Just a bunch of mods that I personally use and find really useful overall. Nothing too crazy or overcomplicated—just a solid collection that improves the game in all the right ways.
body:
This is **my personal modpack** that I use all the time, and honestly, I just love it. **I mainly built it with PvP in mind**, so it’s super smooth, **optimized**, and gives you that clean, responsive feel you want during fights. Everything is tuned to help with performance, visuals, and overall gameplay advantage without ruining the vanilla vibe.

That said, **it’s not just for PvP** at all — **it’s actually a solid 10/10** for survival too. Whether you’re grinding, exploring, or just chilling in your world, it feels great to play with. I also included building tools like **WorldEdit**, so if you’re into making big projects or detailed builds, you’re covered there as well.

Overall, it’s just a really well-rounded pack that works for pretty much everything: PvP, survival, building, whatever you’re into. I’ve put time into making sure everything works nicely together, so you don’t have to deal with random issues or bad performance.

**Just try my pack, it’s actually good vro 🥀🥀🥀**
